value.rationale: The model and pineapple family are independently motivated. A parameter-uniform ten-class temporal census and, stronger, exact identical five-layer attraction profiles for individual oscillatory orbits give first-entry information not encoded by the general prior circulation criterion. The independence from core size and limiting equal weights on three entry times are structural features with plausible use in excitation/propagation studies.
